audience: store teams that run their online shop on Daras

useCases.title: Check which variants need restocking
useCases.text: List the variants at or below their low-stock threshold. Then read the stock of each warehouse to see where the units are.

useCases.title: Set the stock count after a delivery
useCases.text: Read the current quantity of a product in one warehouse. Then set the new on-hand count. The change replaces the stored quantity and updates live stock.

useCases.title: Review fulfillment orders on hold
useCases.text: List the fulfillment orders with status HOLD. Open one to see its lines and status, then read the full order for payment and shipping state.

useCases.title: Answer a customer's shipment question
useCases.text: Find the customer and list their orders. Read the shipping state of one order, then get the tracking events of its shipment.

useCases.title: Review return requests waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the return requests with status REQUESTED. Open one to read its items and status history. This server cannot approve or reject a return.

useCases.title: Update the price of a product variant
useCases.text: Read the product and its variants first. Then change the price, compare-at price or name of one variant. The change updates the live shop price or label.
